description: SQLite schema for the Project Management MVP. Supports multiple users, one board per user, multiple columns and cards per board, and AI conversation history per board.

users.description: Registered users. MVP uses hardcoded credentials; table exists for future multi-user support.

boards.description: One board per user for MVP. title defaults to 'My Board'.

columns.description: Ordered columns within a board. position is 0-indexed integer; 5 fixed columns seeded on board creation.

cards.description: Cards within a column. position is 0-indexed integer within the column.

ai_messages.description: Conversation history for the AI chat sidebar, scoped to a board.

design_decisions.cascade_deletes: Deleting a user cascades to boards → columns → cards and ai_messages. Keeps the DB consistent without application-level cleanup.
design_decisions.position_as_integer: Card and column order stored as 0-indexed integers. On move, affected rows are shifted in a single UPDATE. No fractional/gap strategy needed at MVP scale.
design_decisions.fixed_columns: MVP boards are seeded with 5 fixed columns (Backlog, Discovery, In Progress, Review, Done) on board creation. Columns cannot be added or removed, only renamed.
design_decisions.updated_at_management: updated_at is set by the application layer on every write — no SQLite triggers needed for MVP. SQLAlchemy event listeners will handle it.
design_decisions.password_storage: password_hash stores bcrypt hashes. MVP seed inserts the hash for 'password' directly.
design_decisions.no_soft_deletes: Hard deletes only. Cascade rules handle referential integrity.
design_decisions.foreign_key_enforcement: PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON must be set per connection; SQLAlchemy event listener will emit it on connect.

queries.get_board: Single JOIN across boards + columns + cards ordered by column.position, card.position — no N+1.
queries.move_card_same_column: Shift positions of cards between old and new index, then set card's position.
queries.move_card_different_column: Decrement positions in source column above removed card; insert at target position and increment positions in target column.
queries.get_conversation_history: SELECT * FROM ai_messages WHERE board_id = ? ORDER BY created_at ASC — straightforward.
